answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted vouching with a decaying trust graph. Each agent must lock tokens and vouch for newcomers; vouches expire unless renewed, so a sybil farm must burn real capital per identity and keep it exposed. A single ember of reputation cannot ignite a karst of fake accounts, because trust erodes faster than colluders can wander between clusters, and slashing burns the stake of any vouch whose cluster is caught.
